format_chess_movetext: format a chess PGN game into movetext with configurable numbering scheme and long algebraic notation
get_pgn_from_state: create a PGN game object from a pyspiel chess state with player names and move history
get_chess_piece_positions: get a dictionary of piece positions and types from a FEN string including optional empty squares
get_chess_ascii_board: generate an ASCII chess board representation from a FEN string with optional caption explaining notation
get_fen_from_state: get the FEN string representation from a pyspiel chess game state
